state.task: Audit invoice and payment CSV exports, identify data quality and reconciliation discrepancies, then write a concise report.

catalog.description: Reconcile invoice and payment CSV files by invoice ID, identify unmatched invoices, overpayments and amount mismatches.
catalog.excerpt:
# financial-reconciliation
Read source CSV files. Join by invoice ID; use exact decimal arithmetic. Report paid, underpaid, overpaid and missing payments.

catalog.description: Validate CSV exports for missing fields, duplicate record IDs and malformed amounts. Use for CSV data quality audits.
catalog.excerpt:
# csv-validation
Read the CSV with the ordinary read tool. Validate every record and explain missing values, duplicate IDs and invalid decimal amounts. Never silently coerce bad data.

catalog.description: Write a concise human-readable discrepancy report for a data audit, with references to affected records and next actions.
catalog.excerpt:
# audit-reporting
Report concrete discrepancies by record ID, separate known facts from uncertainty, and keep proposed actions advisory.
